title: Split global P007 pressure-shell refresh from local J2 contact/seal/preload qualification

T07A_global_pressure_shell.support_boundary: J2 mating face support appropriate to global P007 shell screening; do not infer local clamp/seal contact acceptance

decision.separation_rule: T07A may close pressure-shell structural refresh only. It shall not clear T04/T05/T06, C12 leak acceptance, or local J2 process/inspection requirements.

reason: The global ±0.20 bar shell stability check has released pressure and frozen geometry inputs and can be run without inventing unresolved local seal/preload assumptions. Local J2 contact/service qualification remains a separate dependent lane.
rollback: If T07A shows a geometry/material deficiency or becomes sensitive to unresolved local contact assumptions, return T07A to HOLD and reopen the relevant upstream design node.
